overall_notes: This paper focuses on human evaluation of LLM-generated African American English (AAE) text continuations. The study uses three LLMs (GPT-4o-mini, Llama-3-70B-Instruct, Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct) to generate text continuations from interview dialogues sourced from CORAAL, Twitter AAE corpus, and NPR interview corpus. Evaluation is conducted entirely through human annotations using 5-point Likert scales across six criteria. No automatic metrics or LLM-as-judge methods are used.
